subject: [PATCH v3 10/12] nfsd: check fi_had_conflict under deleg_lock before hashing a delegation

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the NFSv4 delegation handling code by checking for conflicts under the deleg_lock before hashing a delegation. This prevents a situation where a lease break can occur between setting fi_had_conflict and hashing the delegation, leading to a delegation being granted that is already recalled but not on the del_recall_lru list. The patch addresses an issue introduced by a previous change that removed the need for taking fi_lock in nfsd_break_deleg_cb().
